qualification: Board scope only: this board contributes the kernel, the loader and the board component; the signed root, the authenticated metadata and the component installation are the board-independent path every product is verified through. No s905x5m image had been published before this release, so the signed file-image check below is the first exercise of that path for this board. Physical s905x5m boot, power-cut, watchdog and USB recovery flashing remain untested, the dossier's physical rows remain untested, and Bluetooth pairing with a controlled peer is untested. One property is specific to this board and recorded rather than left to be discovered: its U-Boot does not rebuild byte-identically, because the vendor signing step is not deterministic, so a rebuilt loader always differs from the published one. Development signing inputs only; conservative I1 grade, the same as cx3576 at the same support tier, retained pending physical and operational qualification.

evidenceRefs.ref: mica-build:src/cli.ts verify --board s905x5m; the board-independent signed file-image checks

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Open on the bench; no closed or fused state is documented or enforced for any revision, and the policy is per board and recorded here (mica:docs/design/manufacturing.md section 6).
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: Present in the field with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (mica:docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: Amlogic USB burning mode, entered through the board's aml_sdc_burn flow and its update.img container; open to anyone with physical access, and it is the recovery path and the stated physical-access boundary (mica:docs/design/manufacturing.md section 6).
